steps.title: Initialize App Metadata and Schema
steps.description: Configure app metadata containing the package name and name, and specify the backend collection structures and local business logic formula in api_schema.json.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build File
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with target SDK 34, proper compilation parameters, and dependency-free native configurations using pure Android SDK.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with native Material Light theme, appropriate activities, and permission declarations for Internet.

steps.title: Create Premium Design Theme Assets
steps.description: Create premium custom shape drawables for rounded buttons, beautiful input edit fields, and elegant cards.

steps.title: Create Native Sound Utility Helper
steps.description: Develop SoundHelper.java utilizing native Android ToneGenerator to provide real-time audio sound feedback effects for app actions offline.

steps.title: Create Native HTTP Backend API Client
steps.description: Implement BackendApi.java utilizing native HttpURLConnection, robust JSON parsing for dynamic CRUD on the cloud notes, register/login, and password recovery.

steps.title: Build Image Helper Utility
steps.description: Implement a helper to load dynamic images matching note categories asynchronously using simple native thread streams and bitmap decoding.

steps.title: Design Premium Login Activity UI and Controller with Sound
steps.description: Develop the user login screen layout and Java class with dynamic App ID loading from assets and audio triggers for successful or failed login attempts.

steps.title: Design Premium Register Activity UI and Controller with Sound
steps.description: Create the signup form interface and register controller supporting standard email registration and audio effects for validation states.

steps.title: Design Premium Forgot Password Activity UI and Controller with Sound
steps.description: Build UI and backend integration for requesting OTP verification and resetting user password dynamically, with sound effects for feedback status.

steps.title: Develop Note Model and Custom Adapter
steps.description: Implement Note model and custom BaseAdapter to dynamically populate notes list with styled title, date, status, category badge, and beautiful images.

steps.title: Create Premium Main Dashboard UI and Logic with Sound
steps.description: Assemble the note list screen featuring search queries, type filtering, local statistic calculation (totals, active vs completed), and note display adapter with interactive click sounds.

steps.title: Create Premium Note Detail Activity with Multi-Image Picker
steps.description: Assemble screens to view, add, update, and delete individual notes, featuring an interactive horizontal image variant selector gallery with instant click sounds.

steps.title: Building Cloud Notes Pro
steps.description: Final compilation using the native Android environment without any external libraries.
